title: Installation Jobs Compliance Fee Note: Lead-Safe Fee Amount
content:
**Compliance fee note — amount of the lead-safe fee on Installation Jobs**

The lead-safe fee on an **Installation Jobs** record is the method's lead-safe fee per opening multiplied by the openings on the job, never less than the method's minimum per job. It is assessed once and dated the job's first crew day. Both figures are those of the job's installation method, shown in the product's compliance rate sheet.

The openings on the job are the openings or door units the job installs. The minimum per job is compared only with the method's lead-safe fee per opening multiplied by the openings on the job. Any other amount added to the fee or taken off it — including an amount stated per opening, which is multiplied by the openings on the job — joins after that comparison, and the result is not compared with the minimum again. The fee is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.

## Elements of the charge

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Per-opening amount | the method's lead-safe fee per opening, multiplied by the openings on the job |
| Floor | the method's minimum per job |
| Frequency | once per job |
| Date | the job's first crew day |

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures: 45.00 per opening, minimum 175.00)

| Openings on the job | Per-opening amount | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 135.00 | 175.00 — the minimum, since 135.00 is less |
| 4 | 180.00 | 180.00 |
| 10 | 450.00 | 450.00 |

## Points of the note

- **The floor.** The minimum per job is a floor on the per-opening amount, not an addition to it.
- **Which date.** The first crew day of the job fixes the date of the fee.
